hero.title: Panambur
hero.description: Discover the golden sands of Panambur Beach in Mangalore, enjoy exciting water sports, stunning Arabian Sea views and beautiful sunsets along Karnataka’s coastline.

overview.title: About Panambur Beach
overview.p1: Panambur Beach is one of Mangalore’s popular coastal destinations, known for its golden sands, scenic Arabian Sea views and beautiful sunsets. Located near New Mangalore Port in Karnataka, the beach attracts visitors looking to enjoy the sea breeze, relax along the shoreline and experience the lively atmosphere of Mangalore’s coastline.
overview.p2: Panambur Beach is known for its beach activities, seasonal kite festival events and opportunities to enjoy the coastal scenery. Visitors can explore the sandy shoreline, capture sunset photographs and discover nearby food stalls serving local snacks and seafood. Water sports and other activities may be available depending on the season, weather and operator schedules.
highlights: Golden Sands & Scenic Coastline
Sunset Views Over the Arabian Sea
Seasonal Kite Festival & Beach Events

overview.title: About Tannirbhavi Beach
overview.p1: Tannirbhavi Beach is a peaceful coastal destination in Mangaluru, known for its sandy shoreline, scenic Arabian Sea views and relaxing atmosphere. Away from the busier parts of the city, it offers visitors a lovely place to enjoy the sea breeze, unwind by the water and appreciate Karnataka's natural coastline.
overview.p2: Visitors can take leisurely beach walks, capture beautiful sunset photographs and enjoy the surrounding coastal scenery. Tannirbhavi Beach can also be reached by road or, when operating, by ferry from the Sultan Battery area, adding a scenic touch to your Mangaluru sightseeing experience.
highlights: Scenic Sandy Shoreline & Arabian Sea Views
Peaceful Coastal Escape for Families
Beautiful Sunset Views & Photography

hero.description: A peaceful coastal escape in Mangaluru, Thannirbhavi Beach is known for its golden sands, Arabian Sea views, gentle waves, and beautiful sunsets.

overview.title: About Kadri Manjunath Temple
overview.p1: Kadri Manjunath Temple is one of the most historic temples in Mangaluru, Karnataka. Located on Kadri Hill, this ancient shrine is dedicated to Lord Manjunatha, a form of Lord Shiva. Known for its traditional architecture, spiritual atmosphere, and rich cultural heritage, the temple attracts devotees and visitors throughout the year.
overview.p2: The temple is admired for its ancient bronze deity, sacred water ponds known as Gomukhas, and connections to the region's Buddhist and Hindu traditions. Surrounded by greenery, the temple complex offers a peaceful setting for prayer, reflection, and cultural exploration. Visitors can also appreciate its traditional shrines, stone structures, and distinctive heritage.

hero.title: Light House
hero.description: Visit Light House Hill in Hampankatta, Mangaluru, a historic city landmark featuring a peaceful garden, scenic surroundings, and views towards the Arabian Sea. It is a lovely stop for a relaxing walk and exploring the city's heritage.

overview.title: About Light House Hill Garden
overview.p1: Light House Hill, located in Hampankatta in central Mangaluru, is a historic landmark associated with Hyder Ali and the region's maritime past. The hill features the old lighthouse within Tagore Park, offering visitors a glimpse into the city's heritage and its connection to coastal navigation.
overview.p2: The area is a convenient stop for travellers exploring central Mangaluru, with nearby streets, historic institutions, and local landmarks adding to its appeal. Visitors can enjoy a short walk, appreciate the surroundings, and learn about the city's past. The site's present-day views and facilities may differ from historical descriptions, so plan your visit with realistic expectations.
highlights: Historic landmark linked to Hyder Ali and Mysore's maritime history
Old lighthouse located within Tagore Park
Central location in Hampankatta, Mangaluru
A convenient stop for heritage walks and nearby attractions

hero.title: Netravati
hero.description: Discover the beautiful Netravati River in coastal Karnataka, known for its scenic riverbanks, peaceful waters, lush surroundings, and its connection to the cultural life of Mangaluru.

overview.title: About Netravati River
overview.p1: Originating in the Western Ghats near Kudremukh, the Netravati River flows through Karnataka’s Dakshina Kannada region before joining the Gurupura River near Mangaluru and reaching the Arabian Sea. The river plays an important role in the region’s natural landscape, supporting local communities, agriculture, and diverse ecosystems. Its scenic riverbanks and coastal estuary make it a notable feature of Mangaluru.
overview.p2: The Netravati River offers opportunities to enjoy peaceful waterfront views, observe local fishing activities, and photograph the beautiful coastal scenery. The estuary near Ullal is particularly appealing around sunset, when the river and sea create a picturesque setting. Visitors can explore nearby riverside areas and enjoy local seafood, while checking boat availability and safety conditions before planning water activities.
highlights: Scenic river flowing from the Western Ghats to the Arabian Sea
Beautiful estuary views near Ullal and the Mangaluru coast
Traditional fishing activities and local coastal culture
Peaceful waterfront scenery and sunset photography opportunities

hero.title: Sultan
hero.description: Explore Sultan Battery in Boloor, Mangaluru, a historic stone watchtower built during Tipu Sultan’s rule. Discover its coastal defence history, enjoy views of the Gurupura River, and visit the nearby ferry point for a scenic journey towards Tannirbhavi Beach.

overview.title: About Sultan Battery
overview.p1: Sultan Battery is a historic stone watchtower located in Boloor, Mangaluru, Karnataka. Built in 1784 during the reign of Tipu Sultan, it served as a coastal defence structure intended to guard the entrance to the Gurupura River against enemy vessels. Its distinctive dark stone architecture and strategic riverside location make it an important landmark in Mangaluru's history.
overview.p2: Today, Sultan Battery is a popular stop for visitors interested in local history and coastal scenery. Travellers can admire the old watchtower, enjoy views of the Gurupura River, and explore the nearby waterfront. A ferry service from the surrounding area may provide access towards Tannirbhavi Beach, depending on current operations. The site is ideal for a short visit, photography, and learning about Mangaluru's maritime past.
highlights: Historic stone watchtower built during Tipu Sultan’s reign in 1784
Strategic location overlooking the Gurupura River entrance
Popular landmark for heritage exploration and photography
Nearby ferry access towards Tannirbhavi Beach, subject to availability
